# StockMate POS (OmniStock): Full System Architecture & API Context

## System Architecture
StockMate POS is structured around 8 core retail operational modules:
1. Inventory Management & SKU catalog
2. Point of Sale & Receipt printer simulator
3. Barcode scanner & AI Catalogue digitizer
4. Purchase orders & Supplier tracking
5. Customer CRM & Loyalty point engine
6. Pricing & Profit margin calculator
7. Recipe yield costing
8. Automated Google Sheets sync & Email reports
